name: SaveGame_Write
evidence: Builds the 0xF0 header (title/company/city/slots/date), writes it, then serializes game state.

name: SaveGame_SerializeRuntimeList
evidence: Writes a fixed runtime object list (presence flag + fields) near the end of the save.

name: SaveGame_DeserializeRuntimeList
evidence: Reads the runtime object list and restores it.

name: SaveGame_Serialize
evidence: Payload writer: reserved block, 0x2e marker, 0x5B8 global block, 20 scalars, subsystem serializers, 0x2a end marker.
